Jurgen Klopp wears Germany cap, sparking debate

Football manager Jurgen Klopp wore a cap bearing the German flag, a gesture interpreted by some as a political statement. The cap featured the colours black, red, and gold, and was seen by some as a response to the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party. Klopp himself described the cap as representing '83 million Germans'. The significance of this gesture and its potential political implications have been a subject of discussion.
